过影响CYP450、P-糖蛋白( p-gp) 、孕烷 X 受体( PXR) 、核因子相关因子( Nrf2) 、多药耐药相关蛋白( MRP1) 等来改变其他药物的吸收和代谢等过程。本文对五味子的化学成分以及和其他药物相互作用的机制进行了综述。Action Mechanism Development of Drug Interactions between Schisandra Chinensis and Other Drugs
Yang Yan，Xin Huawen ( Wuhan General Hospital of Guangzhou Military，Wuhan 430070，China)ABSTRACT The major chemical constituents in Schisandra chinensis are schizandrin B，schisantherrin A，deoxyschisandrin， schisantherrin B，schisandrol B and so on． Schisandra chinensis affects the absorption and metabolism of other drugs through its effects on CYP 450，P-glycoprotein ( p-gp) ，pregnane X receptor ( PXR) ，NF-E2-related factor 2( Nrf2) and multidrug resistance-associated proteins 1 ( MRP1) ． The chemical components and the action mechanism of Schisandra chinensis on other drugs were summarized in the paper KEY WORDS Schisandra chinensis;Drug interaction;Cytochrome P450;
